name: Rotational link
description: A rigid link that swings about a joint. Angle (rad) and Angular velocity (rad/s) both start at 0. The node's own equation makes Angle change at the rate of Angular velocity, so you only need to act on Angular velocity: connect Rotational drive from a Motor. Unlike a Torque load it is a body that moves, so its Angle can be read by a controller such as Position control.
